## 📦 Downloads

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `flutter-vpn-go-*-arm64-v8a.apk` | Android — modern devices (ARM64, recommended) |
| `flutter-vpn-go-*-armeabi-v7a.apk` | Android — older devices |
| `flutter-vpn-go-*-x86_64.apk` | Android — emulator |
| `flutter-vpn-go-*-universal.apk` | Android — all architectures |
| `flutter-vpn-go-*.aab` | Android App Bundle (Google Play) |

| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums for all files |

## Upgrade Instructions

1. Download the appropriate file for your platform.
2. Back up your configuration from **Settings** tab before upgrading.
3. Install over the existing app.

## Requirements

- **Android:** 8.0+ (API 26+), VPN permission required
- **iOS:** 15.0+, real device required (Simulator not supported for VPN)
